newsitem.title: UK: UK's RPS buys Dutch group BAK, makes placing.
newsitem.headline: UK's RPS buys Dutch group BAK, makes placing.

text.p: British environmental consultancy company RPS Group Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Dutch environmental engineering company BAK Nederland Beheer B.V. for just under 3.0 million stg.
RPS also announced the placing of 947,5665 new shares at 190 pence a share to raise 1.8 million stg to provide funds for further acquisition opportunities.
In addition to this placing, RPC said it is issuing 776,842 vendor consideration shares to be placed at 190 pence to cover the first tranche of its payment for BAK.
The total consideration for BAK is 9.43 million guilders (2.98 million stg), payable in three tranches.

The first tranche, covered by the vendor share placing, amounts to 4.68 million guilders (1.48 million stg) and is payable on completion, expected on April 24. The second and third tranches of 2.50 and 2.25 million guilders are due 12 and 24 months later respectively.
The deferred payments, payable in cash, are conditional on future performance, RPS said in a statement.
RPS, which seeks to expand its UK base by purchases in Europe, said the acquisition provides an opportunity to extend its range of services in the Netherlands.
BAK, whose operations cover all aspects of environmental engineering, specialises in the oil, gas, chemical and petrochemical sector, complementing RPS's operations in Aberdeen, Scotland, RPS said.
Dealings in all the new shares are expected to start on April 24.
